facts.fact: A Rwanda Land Management and Use Authority informant told INCLUDE's researchers that all land transfer applications, about 200 a day per district, are reviewed at sector level by one member of staff who can examine 40 at most; the applications arrive through the Irembo platform, whose back office public servants use to process them (no date given; dated to publication, September 2022).
facts.system: sector offices reviewing land applications in the Irembo back office and digital land registry

facts.fact: INCLUDE's 2022 study gives no count of connected local offices; it lists as a challenge that infrastructure and connectivity remain problematic especially at sector and cell level in peri-urban and rural areas, citing Khan (2022), and says government agencies rely on internet services from private mobile networks (dated to publication, September 2022).
facts.system: connectivity at sector and cell level

systems.platform: Irembo (front office for citizens, back office for public servants)
systems.owner: government e-service platform under MINICT and RISA; back-office operations under each institution
systems.tiers: national; land applications reviewed at sector level; birth certificate listed as a Ministry of Local Government service
